summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing routine updates to its holdings of cash, Bitcoin, shares of STRC Stock, and outstanding shares. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or similar special situation is announced. The filing solely provides periodic financial data and forward-looking statements regarding a previously announced merger with Semler Scientific. It does not trigger any category under special situations.
